description: A minimalist desk setup featuring a sleek, dark red tabletop supported by a slender black metal frame. On the desk, a retro-style white computer monitor and keyboard are accompanied by a black desk lamp and a coffee mug, suggesting a workspace. To the right, a pair of black headphones rests, hinting at audio or creative use. A simple, matching red stool with a black metal base is positioned in front of the desk. The overall aesthetic is clean and functional, with a slightly vintage computer adding a touch of nostalgia.
